These three gzip-compressed one-page PDFs contain invented text and painted
vector rules. Decompression restores the exact diagnostic input bytes.
The adjacent grids have four and two columns, with a seven-point blank gap.
The reverse-paint file changes stream order while preserving the raster.
The continuous control contains one grid. The generator is in the signed
qualification commit `b5057b76fe`, at
`scripts/ci/qualification/adjacent-native-tables/qualify.py`.
